cnam-index-title: Easily generate the complete description of a CNAM program.
cnam-index-subtitle: All teaching units will be detailed.
docs.title: Project documentation
docs.overview.title: Overview
docs.overview.p: CNAM+ Simple extracts and caches cursus data from bedeo.cnam.fr and exposes a small API and a lightweight frontend to search and export cursus descriptions.
docs.goals.title: Goals
docs.goals.item2: Cache results to reduce remote requests
docs.goals.item4: Provide a simple UI to search and download descriptions
docs.architecture.title: Architecture
docs.architecture.p: Monorepo with two apps: a React frontend (client) and a Cloudflare Worker backend (scraper + API).
docs.frontend.title: Frontend (client)
docs.frontend.p: React + Vite, TailwindCSS + HeroUI, i18n support, lightweight UI for searching curricula and downloading JSON/Markdown.
docs.backend.title: Backend (worker)
docs.backend.p: Cloudflare Workers providing scraping logic (Playwright), KV caching, and REST endpoints for cursus data.
docs.install.title: Installation & Development
docs.install.p: Requirements: Node.js 24+, Yarn 4+. Install dependencies with `yarn install`. Start dev: `yarn dev:env`.
docs.tests.title: Testing
docs.tests.p: Backend tests use Vitest and Cloudflare worker pool. Run tests in `apps/cloudflare-worker` with `yarn test`.
docs.api.title: API
docs.api.p: Main endpoint: GET /api/cursus/<code>. Supports `enrich=true` and secure cache invalidation.
